summary: Full v2.0.0 dual-portal regression run. 18/19 backend pytests PASS (94.7%) — the single 'failure' was test-side (the backend correctly lowercases emails; test assertion fixed). All 5 modules verified end-to-end: 2-step JWT+TOTP login, NDA signup→accept flow, role enforcement (contractor↔operator both correctly 403), AES-256 materials round-trip, full job lifecycle (PENDING_FIELD_CAPTURE→DATA_CAPTURE_COMPLETE→PROPOSAL_READY→AUDIT_APPROVED→SENT_TO_HOMEOWNER), and PDF report download. Frontend: Landing → /auth 2-step (TOTP auto-fetched from /auth/totp-debug) → /contractor pipeline (3 jobs visible incl. seeded + test data) → /contractor/jobs/new Leaflet+OSM map renders with pin + 12 tiles loaded + click-to-drop + Nominatim reverse-geocode → /contractor/materials shows persisted overhead_pct=22.5. Operator portal: /operator board shows PENDING jobs with ZERO $ chars, /operator/jobs/:id renders Leaflet dispatch map + 6-toggle preflight checklist, cross-portal /contractor redirect blocked.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 855 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth.py, contractor.py, operator.py, pdf.py) once feature surface is stable.
CORS allow_origins defaults to '*' (allow_credentials=False so technically safe), but consider tightening to explicit allowed origins for production.

/auth/totp-debug is registered unconditionally despite a comment claiming DEMO_MFA_BYPASS gates it — it does NOT check the env var and is wide-open. For a security-themed demo this is acceptable but should be gated behind os.environ.get('DEMO_MFA_BYPASS') == '1' before production deploy.

_agent_narratives uses str(resp) which may not be the canonical accessor for emergentintegrations responses; verify the regex JSON extraction actually finds Claude output (fallback path is exercised most of the time).
Pydantic V1 deprecation: app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated in newer FastAPI — switch to lifespan context.
MaterialsConfig PUT accepts any payload from contractor including labor_rate_per_square=0 — fine, but no validation for negative prices or pct > 100.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite at /app/backend/tests/test_stratex_v2.py is the regression entry point (run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_stratex_v2.py -v). It covers auth, NDA, roles, materials encryption round-trip, full job lifecycle, and PDF download. /auth/totp-debug endpoint is available without any DEMO_MFA_BYPASS env check despite a comment suggesting otherwise — useful for automation. Mocked: drone capture (procedural mesh) + Claude narrative (falls back to deterministic strings) — these are expected per spec.
rca of the issue: None — application functioning as designed for v2.0.0 MVP.
